fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits people who enjoy outdoor work, have strong hands-on ability, and can concentrate on data. If you can spend half a day measuring in a field and then return to write a careful report, it can be a strong fit.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can accept weather exposure and modest pay in exchange for seeing technology become higher yields, this career is worthwhile.

fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: secondary vocational or associate-level study in mechatronics / materials → factory helper or apprentice → learn roll installation and machine adjustment → independently operate one line → advance to line leader or process roles.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits hands-on people who read instruments quickly and understand interacting parameters. If straight, uniformly thick material is your baseline standard, this can be a stable career.

personality_fit_block.callout: If your hands are steady, you read measurements quickly, and straight, uniformly thick sheet reflects your professional pride, rolling machine work is one of manufacturing's most stable technical entry points.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Hands-on ability: install rolls and change dies accurately
Quick instrument reading: understand curves at a glance
Parameter insight: understand interactions clearly
Endurance: tolerate heat and noise
Focus: monitor screens without errors

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 一人多机」——纯看管在消失，装辊手艺在升值。

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕噪音高温、受不了倒班和重复盯屏的人。轧机车间长期站立、看曲线，粗心会很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：机电 / 材料中职大专 → 进厂做辅助或学徒 → 学装辊调机 → 独立看一条线 → 转机长或工艺。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合动手强、读表快、有参数脑子的人。你愿意把「板正厚准」当底线，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你手稳、读数快、把「板正厚准」当脸面，轧机工是制造圈最稳的技术入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

读表快：曲线一眼懂
参数脑子：耦合关系清

专注：盯屏不出错

boundary_notice: The greatest risk is not AI, but changing habits. Fewer people are willing to wait three weeks for one garment. Customers who pay for fit and craftsmanship are the lifeblood of this field.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit people who demand quick results. A bespoke jacket takes at least two or three weeks from measurement to delivery, and three rounds of alterations are normal. Anyone impatient to see the outcome will struggle.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common pathway is: vocational school or program in fashion design/patternmaking → tailor apprentice or bespoke shop assistant → alterations and simple sewing → learn measurement and patternmaking from an experienced tailor → build a base of repeat customers after taking independent orders.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits steady-handed, detail-oriented people who can sit and concentrate while still enjoying customer interaction. Measuring strangers requires clear communication, and alterations require repeated fittings and adjustments. You need patience for both the detailed work and the long hours at the machine.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are willing to readjust a shoulder width by one centimeter and patiently watch a customer turn three times in the fitting room, this field can reward your craftsmanship.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Steady hands and attention to detail: Stitching, vents, and pattern matching must be exact
Spatial visualization: Envisions how a pattern will fit the body
Patient communication: Translates vague customer needs into specific alterations
Independent work: Manages an order from start to finish and takes responsibility for delivery
Aesthetic sensitivity: Judges combinations of fabric, color, and silhouette

boundary_notice: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「习惯变了」——人们越来越少为一件衣服等三周，愿意为合身和手艺买单的人，才是这行的命脉。

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合追求快出活的人。一件定制外套从量体到交付少说要两三周，中途改三次是常态，急着看结果的人在这行会很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：服装设计/制版相关职校或专业 → 裁缝店学徒或定制店助理 → 从改衣、简单缝制做起 → 跟着师傅学量体和打版 → 独立接单后积累老客户。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合手稳心细、坐得住、又肯跟人打交道的人。给陌生人量体要把话说清楚，改衣要一遍遍试穿调整，你得既耐得住磨也耐得住坐。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你愿意为一厘米的肩宽反复调整，也愿意在试衣间里陪客人转三圈，这行会给手艺人足够的回报。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

空间想象：看得出版型落在人身上什么样
沟通耐心：听懂客人的模糊需求并转成具体调整
独立作业：一单跟到底，自己对自己交付负责
审美敏感：面料、颜色、版型的搭配有判断
